resources.string: Goes out on time, even with your devices off, unless the group changes and all your devices stay off.
Messages with files can\'t wait yet: send them now.
Pick a time in the future.
That is further ahead than your workspace allows.

The server keeps these, encrypted, and sends them on time, even with your devices off. If the group changes (someone joins or leaves), this phone updates the encryption in the background; only if that fails and all your devices stay off does a message wait for one to come back. Android can delay this.
Nothing scheduled. Use \"Send later\" behind the + in the composer.
The group changed. One of your devices updates the encryption by itself; it goes out on time if one does in time.
Late: the group changed and none of your devices got to it. It goes out as soon as one does.
You\'re no longer in this conversation, so it won\'t go out.
You may no longer post in this conversation, so it didn\'t go out.
This conversation was deleted, so it won\'t go out.
The thread it answers is gone, so it didn\'t go out.
This device can\'t read it yet. It still goes out.
Your workspace turned scheduling off. It stays here until you send or cancel it.
Your app can\'t tell what happens to this message. Update it.
Cancel this message? Nobody will see it.
A scheduled message needs you. Tap to see it.
The server removed it after holding it this long, so it won\'t go out. The text is only on your devices now: copy it if you still need it.
The server removes it on %1$s. Copy the text before then if you need it.
Remove it from this device? Its text is gone from here then.
That\'s too long for the server. Shorten it and try again.
